response.rationale: Biopsy shows myositis with lymphoid hyperplasia, which is characteristic of Kimura disease (a chronic inflammatory head/neck mass). Other candidates either lack specific support (IgG4-RD, Sjögren, Rosai-Dorfman) or are contradicted by biopsy (lymphoma, sarcoma).

rejected.why: Biopsy contradicts malignancy; no specific support.
Myositis is a histologic description, not a specific diagnosis; lacks lymphoid hyperplasia context.
No histiocytic features or specific evidence for Rosai-Dorfman.
Biopsy contradicts lymphoma; only differential list.
Lymphoid hyperplasia alone is nonspecific; no IgG4-related features.
No sicca symptoms or salivary gland predilection.
